
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/developer-tianyiyun/p/19148106" title="发布于 2025-10-17 15:42">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">nginx证书缓存功能</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本文分享自天翼云开发者社区《<a href="https://www.ctyun.cn/developer/article/614224557408325" rel="noopener nofollow">nginx证书缓存功能</a>》.作者：云海</p>
<h1>背景：</h1>
<p>ssl证书之前是不支持公用的，不同的域名，如果引用同一本证书，是无法公用的，每个域名都要加载同一个证书，浪费内存</p>
<h1>新版本：</h1>
<p>在1.27.2版本中，nginx官方更新了ssl证书相关的实现，支持了ssl证书缓存共享。</p>
<h1>实现原理：</h1>
<p>在配置初始化时，初始了ssl证书缓存的红黑树：<br><code>ngx_openssl_cache_create_conf -&gt; ngx_rbtree_init</code></p>
<p>在要获取ssl证书时，通过如下接口获取对应ssl证书：<br>ngx_ssl_cache_fetch<br>该接口的index参数可以传递不同的标记位，因为不同功能ssl证书有不同的创建释放和引用增加处理<br>不同功能ssl证书有如下定义：<br><code>typedef struct {</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_ssl_cache_create_pt &nbsp; &nbsp; create;</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_ssl_cache_free_pt &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; free;</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_ssl_cache_ref_pt &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;ref;</code><br><code>} ngx_ssl_cache_type_t;</code></p>
<p>核心函数分析：<br><code>void *</code><br><code>ngx_ssl_cache_fetch(ngx_conf_t *cf, ngx_uint_t index, char **err,</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_str_t *path, void *data)</code><br><code>{</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; uint32_t &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; hash; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 用于存储计算出的哈希值</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_ssl_cache_t &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; *cache; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 指向 SSL 缓存的指针</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_ssl_cache_key_t &nbsp; &nbsp;id; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 缓存键，用于标识特定缓存项</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_ssl_cache_type_t &nbsp;*type; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 缓存类型对象指针</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_ssl_cache_node_t &nbsp;*cn; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 指向缓存节点的指针</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 初始化缓存键（如失败则返回 NULL）</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; if (ngx_ssl_cache_init_key(cf-&gt;pool, index, path, &amp;id) != NGX_OK) {</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return NULL;</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; }</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 获取全局的 SSL 缓存对象</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cache = (ngx_ssl_cache_t *) ngx_get_conf(cf-&gt;cycle-&gt;conf_ctx,</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;ngx_openssl_cache_module);</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 根据索引获取对应的缓存类型</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; type = &amp;ngx_ssl_cache_types[index];</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 计算缓存键的哈希值</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; hash = ngx_murmur_hash2(id.data, id.len);</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 在缓存中查找节点</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cn = ngx_ssl_cache_lookup(cache, type, &amp;id, hash);</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; if (cn != NULL) {</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 如果找到节点，则调用类型的 ref 函数返回缓存值</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return type-&gt;ref(err, cn-&gt;value);</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; }</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 如果未找到，则分配一个新的缓存节点内存</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cn = ngx_palloc(cf-&gt;pool, sizeof(ngx_ssl_cache_node_t) + id.len + 1);</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; if (cn == NULL) {</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return NULL; // 分配失败，返回 NULL</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; }</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 初始化缓存节点的属性</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cn-&gt;node.key = hash; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 设置节点的哈希键</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cn-&gt;id.data = (u_char *)(cn + 1); &nbsp; // 将 ID 数据存储在分配内存之后</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cn-&gt;id.len = id.len; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 设置 ID 长度</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cn-&gt;id.type = id.type; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 设置 ID 类型</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cn-&gt;type = type; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 设置节点的类型指针</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 复制缓存键数据</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_cpystrn(cn-&gt;id.data, id.data, id.len + 1);</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 调用类型的 create 函数创建缓存值</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; cn-&gt;value = type-&gt;create(&amp;id, err, data);</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; if (cn-&gt;value == NULL) {</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return NULL; // 创建失败，返回 NULL</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; }</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 将新节点插入到缓存的红黑树中</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; ngx_rbtree_insert(&amp;cache-&gt;rbtree, &amp;cn-&gt;node);</code></p>
<p><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; // 返回节点值的引用</code><br><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; return type-&gt;ref(err, cn-&gt;value);</code><br><code>}</code></p>
<p><br>nginx官方此功能并没有开关控制，是默认开启的</p>
</div>
